title: Beyond the Black Box: Integrating Lexical and Semantic Methods in Quantitative Discourse Analysis with BERTopic
abstract: arXiv:2508.19099v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Quantitative Discourse Analysis has seen growing adoption with the rise of Large Language Models and computational tools. However, reliance on black box software such as MAXQDA and NVivo risks undermining methodological transparency and alignment with research goals. This paper presents a hybrid, transparent framework for QDA that combines lexical and semantic methods to enable triangulation, reproducibility, and interpretability. Drawing from a case study in historical political discourse, we demonstrate how custom Python pipelines using NLTK, spaCy, and Sentence Transformers allow fine-grained control over preprocessing, lemmatisation, and embedding generation. We further detail our iterative BERTopic modelling process, incorporating UMAP dimensionality reduction, HDBSCAN clustering, and c-TF-IDF keyword extraction, optimised through parameter tuning and multiple runs to enhance topic coherence and coverage. translated_title: 超越黑箱：在BERTopic定量话语分析中整合词汇与语义方法
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型和计算工具的兴起，定量话语分析的应用日益广泛。然而，依赖MAXQDA和NVivo等黑箱软件可能会损害方法论透明度以及与研究目标的一致性。本文提出了一个混合、透明的定量话语分析框架，结合词汇与语义方法，以实现三角验证、可重复性和可解释性。基于历史政治话语的案例研究，我们展示了使用NLTK、spaCy和Sentence Transformers构建的自定义Python流水线如何实现对预处理、词形还原和嵌入生成的细粒度控制。我们进一步详细介绍了迭代式BERTopic建模过程，其中融合了UMAP降维、HDBSCAN聚类和c-TF-IDF关键词提取，并通过参数调优和多次运行进行优化，以提升主题一致性和覆盖率。通过将精确的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个结合词汇与语义方法的透明混合框架，利用NLTK、spaCy、Sentence Transformers和BERTopic等技术替代黑箱软件，实现定量话语分析的三角验证、可重复性与可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a transparent hybrid framework integrating lexical and semantic methods using NLTK, spaCy, Sentence Transformers, and iterative BERTopic modelling to replace black-box software, enabling triangulation, reproducibility, and interpretability in quantitative discourse analysis.
